questions.question_english: According to Section 15 of the POSH Act, which of the following is NOT a criterion for determining the compensation to be paid to the aggrieved woman?
options_english: The mental trauma, pain, suffering, and emotional distress caused
The loss in career opportunity

questions.explanation_english: Section 15 outlines explicit criteria for determining victim compensation: mental trauma, suffering, emotional distress, lost career opportunities, medical treatment expenses, and respondent’s financial status. Academic qualifications of the aggrieved woman are completely irrelevant to evaluating harm or setting compensation amounts under these governing statutory guidelines and rules.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। धारा 15 पीड़ित को दी जाने वाली क्षतिपूर्ति के लिए स्पष्ट मानदंडों को निर्धारित करती है: मानसिक आघात, पीड़ा, भावनात्मक तनाव, करियर के अवसरों की हानि, चिकित्सा उपचार के खर्चे और प्रतिवादी की वित्तीय स्थिति। पीड़ित महिला की शैक्षणिक योग्यता इन मानदंडों के तहत क्षति का मूल्यांकन करने या क्षतिपूर्ति की राशि निर्धारित करने में पूरी तरह से अप्रासंगिक है।
key_facts: Section 15 outlines criteria for victim compensation.
Academic qualifications are not considered for compensation.
Printed answer key: (D) The academic qualifications of the aggrieved

Section 24

questions.explanation_english: Section 24 prescribes comprehensive child-friendly procedures for recording victim statements during police investigations. Specifically, Section 24(1) mandates that the statement of the child victim shall be recorded by a woman police officer not below the rank of Sub-Inspector, ensuring a sensitive and non-intimidating environment throughout the investigative process.

questions.question_english: If an aggrieved woman approaches the ICC with an oral complaint of sexual harassment, what is the statutory duty of the Presiding Officer or any ICC member?
options_english: Assist her in making the complaint in writing
Reject the oral complaint immediately as only written complaints are statutory
Direct her to file a criminal police complaint at the nearest station instead
Record the oral statement verbatim and treat it as a formal written complaint
questions.explanation_english: Section 9(1) establishes that when an aggrieved woman cannot make a written complaint, the Presiding Officer or any member of the committee must render all reasonable assistance to her for making the complaint in writing. Oral complaints cannot be rejected outright, and committee members must actively facilitate formal documentation.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। धारा 9(1) यह स्थापित करती है कि जब एक पीड़ित महिला लिखित शिकायत नहीं कर सकती, तो अध्यक्ष या समिति का कोई भी सदस्य उसे लिखित शिकायत बनाने में सभी उचित सहायता प्रदान करनी चाहिए। मौखिक शिकायतों को तुरंत अस्वीकार नहीं किया जा सकता है, और समिति के सदस्यों को औपचारिक दस्तावेजीकरण में सक्रिय रूप से सहायता करनी चाहिए।
key_facts: Section 9(1) mandates assistance for oral complaints.
Printed answer key: (A) Assist her in making the complaint in writing

questions.question_english: Does the obligation to report under Section 19 of the POCSO Act require absolute proof of the offence?
options_english: Yes, an FIR can only be filed with concrete physical or forensic evidence
No, mere apprehension or knowledge triggers the duty to report
Yes, direct eyewitness testimony is mandatory before reporting to police
No, but the Principal’s personal satisfaction is required before reporting
questions.explanation_english: The duty to report arises from mere knowledge or reasonable apprehension that an offence has occurred. Section 19(1) establishes that absolute proof or direct physical evidence is not required to trigger this obligation, ensuring prompt intervention by child protection authorities whenever suspicion exists regarding potential abuse.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। रिपोर्ट करने की बाध्यता केवल ज्ञान या उचित आशंका से उत्पन्न होती है कि कोई अपराध हुआ है। धारा 19(1) यह स्थापित करती है कि इस बाध्यता को सक्रिय करने के लिए पूर्ण प्रमाण या प्रत्यक्ष भौतिक साक्ष्य की आवश्यकता नहीं है, जिससे संभावित दुरुपयोग के संदर्भ में संदेह होने पर बाल संरक्षण प्राधिकरणों द्वारा त्वरित हस्तक्षेप सुनिश्चित होता है।
key_facts: Section 19(1) establishes the duty to report based on knowledge or apprehension.
Printed answer key: (b) No, mere apprehension or knowledge triggers the duty to report.

questions.question_english: What is the penalty prescribed under Section 17 of the POSH Act for a person entrusted with the duty to handle a complaint if they breach the confidentiality provisions?

A fixed statutory penalty of Rs. 25,000 imposed by court

questions.explanation_english: Section 17 provides that any person who breaches confidentiality requirements regarding inquiry proceedings or personal identities shall be liable to penalty in accordance with applicable service rules. In establishments where no service rules exist, the employer must recover a statutory fine of five thousand rupees from the offender.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। धारा 17 के अनुसार, यदि कोई व्यक्ति जांच की प्रक्रिया या व्यक्तिगत पहचान से संबंधित गोपनीयता आवश्यकताओं का उल्लंघन करता है, तो उसे लागू सेवा नियमों के अनुसार दंड का सामना करना पड़ेगा। जहां कोई सेवा नियम नहीं हैं, वहां नियोक्ता को अपराधी से पांच हजार रुपये का वैधानिक दंड वसूलना होगा।
key_facts: धारा 17 के तहत गोपनीयता का उल्लंघन करने पर दंड का प्रावधान है।
यदि सेवा नियम नहीं हैं, तो 5,000 रुपये का दंड लगाया जाएगा।

questions.question_english:

Reason (R): Section 16 of the POSH Act has an overriding effect on the RTI Act regarding the non-disclosure of the identity of the parties and witnesses.

questions.explanation_english: Section 16 explicitly overrides the Right to Information Act, 2005 by declaring that information regarding the identity and addresses of the aggrieved woman, respondent, and witnesses shall not be published or disclosed. questions.question_english: During the pendency of an inquiry, the aggrieved woman submits a written request to the ICC seeking interim relief. According to Section 12 of the POSH Act, which of the following is a valid recommendation the ICC can make to the employer?

questions.explanation_english: Section 12(1) empowers the committee to recommend interim relief during an inquiry upon written request from the aggrieved woman. Printed answer key: (d) Transfer the aggrieved woman or respondent

questions.question_english: As per the POCSO Rules, what is the timeframe within which the Special Court is expected to complete the trial, as far as possible?
options_english: Within 3 months from the date of taking cognizance of the offence
Within 6 months from the date of taking cognizance of the offence
Within 1 year from cognizance
Within 2 years from the date of filing the police FIR report
questions.explanation_english: Section 35(2) provides that the Special Court shall complete the trial, as far as possible, within a period of one year from the date of taking cognizance of the offence. Adhering to this speedy trial timeline prevents prolonged judicial delays and minimizes emotional uncertainty for child victims and families.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। धारा 35(2) के अनुसार, विशेष न्यायालय को अपराध की संज्ञान लेने की तिथि से एक वर्ष के भीतर मुकदमा पूरा करना चाहिए। इस त्वरित मुकदमे की समय सीमा का पालन करने से न्यायिक देरी को रोकने और बच्चे के पीड़ितों और परिवारों के लिए भावनात्मक अनिश्चितता को कम करने में मदद मिलती है।
key_facts: धारा 35(2): विशेष न्यायालय को संज्ञान लेने की तिथि से 1 वर्ष के भीतर मुकदमा पूरा करना चाहिए।
Printed answer key: (c) Within 1 year from cognizance

questions.question_english: Which statutory body at the national level is primarily mandated to monitor the protection of child rights, including safety in schools, under the CPCR Act, 2005?
options_english: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR)
National Institute of Educational Planning and Administration (NIEPA)
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'c' because the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) is the statutory body established to monitor and ensure the protection of child rights in India, including safety in educational institutions. This body plays a crucial role in implementing the provisions of the CPCR Act, 2005, which aims to safeguard children's rights and promote their welfare.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। क्योंकि राष्ट्रीय बाल अधिकार संरक्षण आयोग (NCPCR) वह वैधानिक निकाय है जिसे भारत में बाल अधिकारों की रक्षा की निगरानी और सुनिश्चित करने के लिए स्थापित किया गया है, जिसमें शैक्षणिक संस्थानों में सुरक्षा भी शामिल है। यह निकाय CPCR अधिनियम, 2005 के प्रावधानों को लागू करने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, जिसका उद्देश्य बच्चों के अधिकारों की रक्षा करना और उनके कल्याण को बढ़ावा देना है।
key_facts: The NCPCR is responsible for monitoring child rights and safety in schools.
Printed answer key: (C) National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR)

questions.question_english: To ensure child-friendly procedures, Section 24(4) mandates that the police officer shall ensure the child is NOT brought into contact with whom during the recording of the statement?
options_english: The child’s parents
The medical officer
The accused person
The school counsellor
questions.explanation_english: Section 24(4) mandates that the investigating police officer shall ensure that the child victim is not brought into contact with the accused person at any time during the investigation. Preventing direct exposure or confrontation protects the minor from distress, intimidation, and further psychological trauma throughout formal law enforcement proceedings.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। धारा 24(4) यह अनिवार्य करती है कि जांच करने वाला पुलिस अधिकारी यह सुनिश्चित करे कि बच्चे के पीड़ित को किसी भी समय आरोपी व्यक्ति के संपर्क में नहीं लाया जाए। प्रत्यक्ष संपर्क या आमने-सामने आने से रोकना बच्चे को तनाव, डराने-धमकाने और औपचारिक कानून प्रवर्तन प्रक्रियाओं के दौरान आगे के मनोवैज्ञानिक आघात से बचाता है।
key_facts: Section 24(4) prohibits contact with the accused during investigation.
Protects child from psychological trauma.
Printed answer key: (c) The accused person
